environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: None configured — personal GitHub account `mmedum`, over SSH
**Cloud provider(s)**: None configured

**Repository visibility**: VARIES BY REPO, and most are public. Check before assuming: `gh repo view --json visibility`, or the remote. Where a check is not possible, assume PUBLIC — that is the careful direction
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: None configured

**Default / protected branches**: `main` in every repo here, and origin/HEAD is set in all of them but one local-only repository. The four Go MCP servers (google-{chat,docs,drive,sheets}-mcp) require a pull request into main and CI green on three platforms; their own CLAUDE.md says main is never pushed to directly, release commits included
**CI/CD deploy targets**: None configured. The Go MCP servers publish signed GitHub releases from a `v*` tag — keyless Sigstore signatures, SBOMs and build provenance — so a tag push is a publish
**Network posture**: None configured
**Source control**: GitHub, per repo. Do not assume a repo has no remote; all but one here do
**Trusted internal domains**: None configured
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Key internal services**: None configured
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: any file or store holding personal data, confidential business data, credentials, regulated data, or similarly sensitive material; preserve exact handles when known and share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar. The public repos add a stricter rule of their own: their CLAUDE.md forbids any organisation name, file or folder id, account address, Cloud project id or real file content from appearing in code, docs, fixtures, commit messages or logs — in a public repo that is publication, not disclosure to a colleague
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured

**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment (hyphen/underscore/dot-delimited — e.g. matches `prod-db`, not `producer`)
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development (personal/hobby-leaning; Claude subscription is max)

**Trusted repo**: this block is user-scope and is read in EVERY project, so it names no single repo as the trusted one. ~/.config/omarchy is a local-only working directory with no remote; ~/repos/* are GitHub repos, mostly public. Read the repo you are in rather than the one this file was written for
**Org-specific CLIs**: None configured
